turns_text: [SEG0001] person_1 (NURSE): Good afternoon, Mr Krishnan. I am Sister Latha. Let me just check your pressure and pulse before the doctor calls you.
[SEG0002] person_2 (PATIENT): Yes, sister. Please go ahead.
[SEG0003] person_1 (NURSE): Blood pressure is one twenty-eight over eighty-four. Pulse is seventy-six and regular. Oxygen saturation is ninety-eight percent. You can wait inside, doctor is free.
[SEG0004] person_3 (DOCTOR): Mr Krishnan, I am Dr Menon. Please sit. Your wife is welcome to stay. Tell me, what brings you in today?
[SEG0005] person_2 (PATIENT): Thank you, doctor. I am fine, really. I do not wish to waste your time.
[SEG0006] person_4 (FAMILY_MEMBER): He is not fine, doctor. Please. Since the job went he has become very quiet, and he will not admit it.
[SEG0007] person_3 (DOCTOR): Alright. Mr Krishnan, may I hear your wife first, and then you can correct anything that is not right?
[SEG0008] person_2 (PATIENT): Yes, doctor. That is perfectly fine. She does worry.

[SEG0009] person_4 (FAMILY_MEMBER): He lost his accounts job in February, the logistics firm in Whitefield. Since then sleep is not coming properly, his energy is gone, and he has lost interest in everything. Even Sunday cricket he just sits through, or he leaves the room.
[SEG0010] person_3 (DOCTOR): So, poor sleep, low energy, and loss of interest, starting after the job loss in February. Mr Krishnan, is the sleep at least true?
[SEG0011] person_2 (PATIENT): Well... I am managing, doctor. But yes, sleep has been poor. I lie there and it does not come.
[SEG0012] person_3 (DOCTOR): How long has that been going on?
[SEG0013] person_2 (PATIENT): Um, three months. No, forgive me, that is not right. It is nearer to five months, from just after February.
[SEG0014] person_4 (FAMILY_MEMBER): And he wakes around three or four, most nights, and then he does not go back. I hear him in the hall.
[SEG0015] person_3 (DOCTOR): Early waking on most nights. Let me put that with the five months of poor sleep. What about your energy, Mr Krishnan?
[SEG0016] person_2 (PATIENT): Energy is low, I have to say. I am tired even if I have only been sitting. I used to walk in the evening. Now I do not feel like it at all.
[SEG0017] person_3 (DOCTOR): And the things you usually enjoy?
[SEG0018] person_2 (PATIENT): I have lost interest, doctor. The newspaper I barely open. It is embarrassing to say, but that is the truth.
[SEG0019] person_4 (FAMILY_MEMBER): His mood is flat. He does not laugh at the serials even. Appetite, though, I think is the same. He still finishes his plate.
[SEG0020] person_3 (DOCTOR): Let me ask you directly. Any change in appetite, or in your weight?
[SEG0021] person_2 (PATIENT): Appetite is normal, doctor. Weight I have not checked, but my clothes fit the same.
[SEG0022] person_3 (DOCTOR): I am going to ask something gently, and a plain answer is enough. Have you had thoughts of harming yourself, or that life is not worth living?
[SEG0023] person_2 (PATIENT): No, doctor. Absolutely not. I have never had such thoughts. I would not do that to my family.
[SEG0024] person_4 (FAMILY_MEMBER): I have asked him at home also. Nothing like that. He is low, that is all.
[SEG0025] person_3 (DOCTOR): Thank you. That is clear to me. Are you taking any tablets at present?
[SEG0026] person_2 (PATIENT): Not at present, doctor. The company doctor had started escitalopram, ten milligrams... no, sorry, it was five milligrams, once at night.
[SEG0027] person_3 (DOCTOR): Are you still on that five milligrams?
[SEG0028] person_2 (PATIENT): I stopped it in March. It was making me restless, so I left it after about three weeks.
[SEG0029] person_4 (FAMILY_MEMBER): They had also given zolpidem for sleep, but he never took it. Not even once. The strip is still in the drawer at home.
[SEG0030] person_3 (DOCTOR): So the zolpidem was never taken, and we can leave it. Only escitalopram five milligrams, stopped in March for restlessness. Any blood pressure, sugar, or other illness?
[SEG0031] person_2 (PATIENT): No, doctor. Nothing else. Last year they did a thyroid test, and they said it was borderline. I was not given the paper to keep.
[SEG0032] person_3 (DOCTOR): Borderline, but no report with you. Do you remember the month, or the actual number?
[SEG0033] person_2 (PATIENT): The number I cannot say. Which month, also, I am not sure. Sometime last year only, before this job problem.
[SEG0034] person_3 (DOCTOR): I will not treat that as a confirmed value. My first plan was to start sertraline fifty milligrams today, and repeat the thyroid whenever convenient.

[SEG0035] person_4 (FAMILY_MEMBER): Doctor, before that. His elder brother had a very bad stomach with sertraline, and Arvind is already nervous of tablets after the escitalopram. Also we are seeing Dr Rao, the psychiatrist, on Thursday. It is already booked.

[SEG0036] person_3 (DOCTOR): That does change my plan. Then I will not start any new medicine today. Let us repeat only the TSH first, and please keep that psychiatry visit. We can talk about a tablet once those are done.
[SEG0037] person_2 (PATIENT): That is more acceptable to me, doctor. I am grateful you are not rushing a tablet.

[SEG0038] person_3 (DOCTOR): Still, a few things from your side. Keep one sleep time, no phone once you are in bed, and a short evening walk if even ten minutes is possible. Do not use alcohol to bring sleep on.
[SEG0039] person_2 (PATIENT): I do not take alcohol, doctor. The phone, I admit, is a habit. I will try to keep it out.

[SEG0040] person_4 (FAMILY_MEMBER): I will put the phone in the kitchen. Doctor, can the blood test be today itself? We came from Whitefield and the traffic was quite mad, I do not want a second trip this week.
[SEG0041] person_1 (NURSE): If you order it, doctor, I can take the TSH now. The lab is open till five.
[SEG0042] person_3 (DOCTOR): Yes, Sister, please draw the TSH today. Only TSH, not the full panel. Mr Krishnan, come back to me in two weeks, with the result, and after you have seen Dr Rao.
[SEG0043] person_2 (PATIENT): In two weeks. Yes, doctor. Shall I bring my wife again?
[SEG0044] person_3 (DOCTOR): Please do bring her. And if the low mood becomes much worse, or if any thought of harming yourself appears, do not wait those two weeks. Come earlier, or go to emergency.
[SEG0045] person_4 (FAMILY_MEMBER): We will, doctor. He has been very polite about all this, but I am glad he opened up a little.
[SEG0046] person_2 (PATIENT): I am sorry to have taken your time. I did not want to make a fuss. I will follow what you have said.

[SEG0047] person_3 (DOCTOR): You have not made a fuss. My working impression is a depressive episode after the job loss, though I am not confirming it today. To put it together: poor sleep with early waking, low energy and loss of interest for about five months, no thoughts of self-harm, escitalopram five milligrams stopped in March, no new tablet today, TSH today, and review in two weeks.
[SEG0048] person_2 (PATIENT): That is correct, doctor. Thank you very much.
[SEG0049] person_1 (NURSE): Come along, Mr Krishnan. The blood test is just down the corridor.

spec.situation: Adult with poor sleep, low energy and loss of interest for months after a job loss or bereavement; partner or parent speaks for them; patient says 'I'm fine' then partly opens up; denies thoughts of self-harm clearly (doctor asks gently); medication discussed but not started today.
features: stopped_or_never_taken: a medicine the patient stopped, was never given or only took once ('I stopped it in March'). Status discontinued, not current; a medicine never taken is not recorded as a medication.
doctor_changes_mind: the doctor says one plan, then changes it after new information; the label holds the final plan.
test_result_recalled: the patient reports an old test or result ('they said it was borderline'); recorded as reported history/investigation only as far as said, not as a confirmed value.
self_correction: a speaker states a number, drug name or duration and then corrects it in the same turn or later ('seventy-five... no, hundred and fifty'). The label holds only the corrected value.
